description: The bar chart illustrates the average JGA (Joint Goal Accuracy) score for two models, LLaMA-7B (represented by orange bars) and T5-small (represented by yellow bars), across a series of turn IDs ranging from 0 to 26. The x-axis, labeled "Turn ID," displays the turn number in the dialogue, while the y-axis, labeled "Avg. JGA Score," measures the average joint goal accuracy on a scale from 0.2 to 1.0. For each turn ID, two bars are shown, with the LLaMA-7B model consistently achieving a higher JGA score than the T5-small model. The scores for both models generally decrease as the turn ID increases, indicating a decline in performance over the course of the dialogue. At turn 0, both models achieve the highest scores, with LLaMA-7B reaching approximately 0.97 and T5-small reaching approximately 0.96. The performance gap between the two models remains relatively consistent across all turn IDs, with LLaMA-7B maintaining a slight advantage. The chart includes a legend in the upper right corner that clearly identifies the color coding for each model.
